versions.changelog:
yoooclaw-hotspot-topic-scout-en 1.0.0

- Initial release of Hotspot Topic Scout for content creators and operations teams.
- Aggregates and analyzes both internal notification signals and external web searches to identify timely, high-potential topics.
- Customizable filters for "who to follow", "what to focus on", and "which groups/applications to monitor".
- Excludes irrelevant or low-value notifications (e.g., celebrity gossip, generic traffic topics, family/promotion alerts).
- Outputs concise, classified topic recommendations and inspiration with prioritized, actionable details.
